answer: Agents gain influence only after posting a refundable stake and completing repeated, randomly sampled trades with established peers. A registry ties each reputation score to scarce collateral: if fresh identities coordinate to fake demand, cross-checks reveal their correlated behavior and slash their stakes, while honest accounts recover deposits. Creating many identities therefore requires locking capital whether operating a wharf, selling nectar, or hauling a glacier-sized workload, making a Sybil swarm expensive to sustain.
